experiment_source: the lead claims the E-number (fleet/ecode) and sets it here before the run; run.py refuses stage0 and items until it reads E<digits>
descriptive: a scorecard column (the user asked for the baseline); no reuse/new verdict under either wording of the definition

settings.k_source: paper Sec. 3: the first k = 5 positions (the toolkit's steering and token-relevance tasks use positions 0-4)
settings.pile_source: the 67M's own pretraining corpus (danbraunai/pile-uncopyrighted-tok-shuffled), val rows 0-8191, cached (artifacts/sets/val_0_8192.npy); paper: 10,000 samples of a pretraining corpus (fineweb-1m-sample); 8,192 is the largest cached val set
settings.lens_top_source: paper Sec. 3.1: token relevance is read on the top-20 tokens
settings.random_diffs_source: the paper's baseline directions (Sec. 5) as the toolkit draws them (causal_effect.py _sample_activation_diff_vectors, num_random_diff_vectors 64, a pool of up to 128 texts); here the first 128 positions of Pile val rows 0-127 (the toolkit: chat data, which the 67M has none of)
settings.random_seed_source: new: the random-difference draw; pair-side random update i (E187's BUILT order, reuse then new) draws finetune.random_direction with random_seed + 1 + i
settings.control_source: E237's control state (key_grid predictions control_state: the task with the smallest mean size; c = 1, so the item is its saved 30-step update), a narrow fine-tune with E244's saved gain 16.45 log-odds; its random update is E237's own for that state

thresholds.thresholds_e143_source: E143's filed gain_floor (a share of a gain under 1 log-odds is undefined), inert (a share under 0.05 reads inert on the scorecard) and zero_tol (do-nothing exactness), experiments/holes_fill/results/predictions.json
thresholds.reader_tol_source: E147's reader_neuron_tol, the bar E244 used to repeat a saved reading through the same lo_at path (experiments/refit_96key/results/predictions.json)
thresholds.size_rel_source: E244's size_match_rel: each item's size must equal its source's (E237 stage 1 for the keys, E187 m67.json for the pairs; observed agreement 2e-8 relative)
thresholds.sd_mult_source: new: 'well above' (the cell) read as at least 3 sd of the 64 random-difference directions' shares, measured in stage 0 on the control itself

scalar.name: D, the ADL direction share
scalar.definition: delta_bar_j = mean over the n_pile Pile rows of (W0 + dW) minus W0 block-2 input (the residual after 2 of 4 blocks) at position j < k. For each j, on the task's read rows (E143's rows and log-odds of each row's target at the read position), the fine-tuned model's mean answer log-odds minus the same with its block-2 input's component along delta_bar_j set to the base model's at every position (paper eq. 1-2, the toolkit's base_to_ft patch), over the fine-tune's gain G (E143 lo_at mean minus W0's). D = max over j (the paper reports the maximum over positions). For a random update G is its paired fine-tune's gain. nan when G is under gain_floor.
scalar.blind_to: anything the fine-tune changes after block 2 that does not pass through block 2's input (blocks 2 and 3 can carry the whole gain and D still reads 0); any change that is not one constant direction across unrelated text (a key-dependent change cancels in the mean); the direction's sign and size (only its span is reverted); which subcomponent, neuron or head carries the gain; whether the task is reuse or new.
scalar.column: per built pair: reuse D values, new D values, gap = reuse mean - new mean, call by seed ranges (apart iff the ranges do not overlap), as experiments/method_table/results/final.json holds the other baselines; per key task: D for 3 seeds beside E237's 3 random updates
scalar.side_reading: lens: per j the share of the top-20 logit-lens tokens of delta_bar_j that are among the task's answer tokens (the targets of its read rows; the paper's token relevance with 'relevant' = an answer token, in place of an LLM grader), and the best rank of any answer token; reported, no rule

stage0.order: first and alone, one job; items refuse unless results/stage0.json says passed
stage0.do_nothing: the control state times 0: max |delta_bar| <= zero_tol, every position's removed log-odds and the gain within zero_tol of 0; D is nan (G = 0 under the floor) by the definition
stage0.repeat: the control's gain equals E244's saved gain for it (experiments/key_grid_baselines/results/run/neuron_0_1.json, 16.4505) within reader_tol
stage0.stop_rule: passed iff the do-nothing and the repeat hold AND D(control) >= inert (0.05) AND D(control) > the largest share of the 64 random-difference directions on the control AND D(control) >= D(control's random update) + 3 sd of those 64 shares. Otherwise stop: ADL does not surface this narrow fine-tune and the cell closes on stage 0 (the lead decides).
stage0.lens_check: reported, not a stop: the control's best lens relevance and best answer rank beside its random update's

control.lens_relevance_max: >= 0.05 (one answer token in the top 20 at some position)
control.best_rank: < 518 (the chance median of the best rank of 96 answers among 50,277 tokens is about 50277 / 97)
control.confidence: low: no ADL reading exists on this model; a constant direction at block 2 could carry well under a twentieth of a key-dependent copy gain, which stops the cell (said in advance)

control_random_update.D: |D| < 0.01 (its own gain is about 0, so it has nothing to lose along any direction)

expected.key_items: every task's D above its own random updates' D; no ordering of the five tasks filed
expected.pairs: descriptive: the count of the nine pairs whose ADL gap has the share's sign (reuse higher on all nine at E187's size, experiments/method_table/results/final.json method share) is reported; no expected count is filed and no verdict is given
